invariants.rationale: Parallelism should not be negative; negative values are likely invalid for execution and used to indicate automatic inference or zero parallelism.
The input record list is required for the insert operation and is expected to be non-null at entry.
HoodieWriteConfig is critical for configuring write operations; typically expected to be non-null.
A valid HoodieTable is needed to execute the operation; null would prevent the insert.
The BulkInsertPartitioner instance is essential for repartitioning the records; likely required to be non-null at method entry.
